description: Minimize area over cell orientations in a supplied slicing tree using Stockmeyer's nondominated dimension-pair DP.

source.title: Slicing Floorplan Orientation
source.algorithm_attribution: Stockmeyer's postorder dynamic program stores nondominated height-width pairs and backpointers for slicing-tree subproblems.
source.implementation_status: clean-room bounded profile; all-pairs child joins followed by skyline pruning preserve the source recurrence

input.encoding: [leaf_count,postorder_tokens...]; token 2 is followed by (height,width), token 0 is vertical join, token 1 is horizontal join
input.tree_form: Full binary postfix slicing tree; each internal operator differs from its right internal child. The caller supplies the source's smallest-depth representation.

output.orientation_mask: Bit i is zero for leaf i in its supplied (height,width) orientation and one for the rotated (width,height) orientation; leaves are numbered left to right.

workspace.meaning: At most 15 tree nodes, 256 orientation candidates per node, skyline flags, and staged output.

contract.skyline: Remove a dimension pair if another pair has no greater height and width and is strictly smaller in at least one dimension. For identical pairs retain the lexicographically smallest leaf-orientation bit vector.
contract.bounded_merge: For each internal node, combine every retained child pair and prune the resulting list; this computes the same nondominated recurrence without claiming the source's O(n d) two-pointer scan bound.
contract.tree_normalization: The input is a supplied smallest-depth nonredundant slicing tree. Ports validate the local rule that an internal node differs from its right internal child but do not compare equivalent tree representations.
contract.error_results: Malformed tree/input returns -1. Null output or capacity below 32 returns -2 without writes.

oracle_method: The primary oracle builds and prunes a child-pair dimension skyline at every postfix tree node. The independent verifier enumerates all at most 256 cell-orientation masks and evaluates the supplied tree directly.
